players.doc: Two controller ports (PCSX2 Pad1 and Pad2; a multitap is not modelled).

doc.native: Real 1x emulator output (was a 256x240 placeholder that corrupted integer placement).

render_scale.doc: PCSX2 at 2x (1280x896) is the Deck's usual setting; 3x (1080p class, nine times the fill) drops most 3D games below full speed there.

doc.hardware: consumer CRT, component CRT, or early flat panel
doc.intent: Aspect should follow PCSX2/game widescreen state.
doc.bios: PCSX2 needs at least one legally dumped PS2 BIOS image.
doc.extensions: Only formats PCSX2 opens: it treats a .7z or .zip as an audio CD and boots the BIOS, so neither is offered. .m3u stays: PCSX2 gets the playlist's first disc (emulator.json playlist.open).
